Review and debug the code changes, then build the project:

1. Analyze recent code modifications in the active editor
2. Run static code analysis to identify potential issues
3. Fix any compilation errors or warnings
4. Execute a clean build of the project
5. Verify that the build completes successfully with:
    - No compilation errors
    - No warnings
    - No linting issues
6. Document any fixes applied and remaining non-critical warnings
7. Run the test suite to ensure changes haven't introduced regressions

Expected outcome: A successful build with no errors or warnings.
